judge.notes: The candidate delivers the warm paper direction well: cream ground, dark brown ink, text serif titles, and small-caps metadata running under each title, with a book-measure column around 580px. Stories read as prose-like entries separated by hairline rules rather than list cards, and the thread page nests comments with a gutter rule that makes depth visible. Missing or weak: the front page is a plain stacked list with no visible article-level distinction beyond rules, and the 375px view has the metadata line breaking awkwardly around comment counts; the header nav wraps to two lines on mobile.
